newsitem.title: USA: Gliatech rights plan has 15 pct trigger.
newsitem.headline: Gliatech rights plan has 15 pct trigger.

text.p: Gliatech Inc said Wednesday it adopted a share purchase rights plan with a 15 percent trigger.
The company said rights will be issued to stockholders of record on July 11.
Under the plan, the rights will initially trade together with Gliatech common stock and will not be exercisable.
The rights will become exercisable and allow the holder to acquire Gliatech common stock at a discounted price if a person or group acquires 15 percent or more of the company's outstanding shares.
The plan also includes an exchange option. After the rights become exercisable, the board may effect an exchange of part or all of the rights for shares of Gliatech common stock.
Under this option, Gliatech would issue one share of common stock for each right.
Gliatech said the plan is not a response to any pending takeover or proposed change in control of the company.
